comment_text.value:
> All people want is affordable housing, jobs that let you plan for the future, and healthcare that won't bankrupt you.

Right. I want to see the Democrats campaigning on those things. Midterm is near, they should be getting their We-Wont-Let-AI-Take-Your-Jobs campaign in motion.

> But there's no solution to any of those problems that don't involve some class of investors losing money/power. So we're stuck with MAGA.

You got MAGA because the Dems specifically went the diversity route, instead of at least pretending to address the concerns of the voters.

This time round they've been handed an opportunity on a golden platter: Go anti-AI, at least enough so that people aren't worried about losing their jobs to AI.

They will not see an opportunity like this for a long time, and if MAGA wins again, blame will lie squarely on Dems who decided that arguing about men in women's sport is a productive use of their voter goodwill.

comment_text.value:
While I theoretically agree, the issue is that Trump will connect economical issues to blowing up NATO Article 5, leaving NATO completely, or retracting intelligence or Starlink for Ukraine.

So for the most part, the EU has to work slowly and under the radar.

That said, my worry is that we'll be back to business as usual if the midterms look favorable. Even the urgency present during January's Greenland threats was gone after a few months. I fear that we don't have the long-term focus and planning to make sovereignty really happen. But I'd love to be surprised.

comment_text.value:
We have to take in mind that Russia is also barely alive and on life support

Putin only has one good exit: to fake a strength that at this moment it does not have, and declare the "victory", in the current broke state of this mess. They would try to trick Ukraine to be polite and let them to keep the occupied territories. They would also need to ask the west to remove the sanctions pretty please.

I assume that after all the pain endured, Ukraine will refuse this solution of returning to the starting point where Russia ask for everything and concedes nothing in return. They would had endured all this fighting years and destruction all for losing a quarter of their country. Would be insane to accept this.

And the idea that EU, or Finland, or Poland will accept Baltic states being taken and Russia at their gates is just... hypothetical

Other possible outcome is that EU will not commit this mistake twice, knowing that they are the next in the menu in five years.

So we are again in a false end. Is very unlikely that the war will stop just at time for the midterms.

Putin is insane, is asking again Russian women to make more babies for keeping the war machine greased, and can't be trusted to keep their word to not invade further.
